narration.full_text: Namaste students! Welcome to an exciting journey into our cosmic neighborhood. Today, we're going to embark on an adventure to explore the Solar System. Get ready to discover the wonders that lie beyond our planet and understand the incredible structure that holds it all together. Let's begin!
